# Alert dialog

A dialog that interrupts to confirm an action that cannot be undone.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> A destructive action here is a secondary button, then a confirm page. The dialog is kept only to confirm leaving with unsaved answers. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a>, <a href="./dialog">Dialog</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Deleting, cancelling or overwriting something people cannot get back, when undo is not possible.
- **Not when:** Anything that can be undone (offer undo instead), or a form or task (use a dialog).

Instead:

- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A focused task, not a confirmation.
- [Toast](./toast.md): Undo after the fact, when the action can be reversed.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Delete or remove</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button secondary, then a confirm page with Button danger</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Button primary</div></div><div class="cap">A confirm step prevents a costly error.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A confirmation question</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Say what will happen in plain words, and offer a way back</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A double negative</div></div><div class="cap">Plain words prevent a choice people did not mean. Example: “Do you want to cancel your application? Your answers will be deleted.”</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape cancels, the same as the safe choice. | undefined |
| undefined | Tab stays inside until people choose. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is an alertdialog with a title and a description that names the consequence. undefined
- [ ] Focus starts on the safe choice, never on the destructive one. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add alert-dialog
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads
